highLevelGoal: Turn the real-external-qualified Orca orchestration engine into a self-contained, installable Windows product while preserving the controller as the independent orchestration owner and Git/GitHub as durable cross-agent truth.

checkpoint.summary: Change 025 (Windows productization and controller supervision) is implemented, qualified, folded into openspec/specs/windows-productization/, and archived.
